Posted 'Bad Feeling' dested Bad Feeling Have I; 'Pull All Section on alert' dested Put All Sections On Alert; 'We Must Accelrate our Plans' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans.

The author's 'Cards I would like to add' list is not applied.
